summary.zh-Hans: 卡鲁拉森林步道的主要岔路口设有编号标志，步行和跑步路线也使用颜色标记。
summary.en: Main junctions on Karura Forest trails have numbered markers. Walking and running routes also use colour codes.

names.zh-Hans: 内罗毕国家博物馆鸟类展厅
names.en: Bird Gallery at Nairobi National Museum

summary.zh-Hans: 内罗毕国家博物馆的鸟类展陈按类群展示东非鸟类，包括猛禽、水鸟和太阳鸟。
summary.en: The bird displays at Nairobi National Museum group East African birds by family, including birds of prey, water birds and sunbirds.

summary.zh-Hans: 乌伽黎可用玉米粉和水煮成结实的稠团，搭配蔬菜或肉类菜肴。肯尼亚也有使用其他谷物或混合粉的做法。
summary.en: Ugali can be made by cooking maize flour with water until firm and served with vegetable or meat dishes. Kenyan versions also use other grains or blended flours.

summary.zh-Hans: 尼亚玛乔马是以明火烤制的肉，可以使用山羊肉、绵羊肉或牛肉。
summary.en: Nyama choma is meat roasted over an open flame; it can be goat, sheep or beef.
